changelog: Fixed ESX and QB-Core: player, job, items and admin were not read, so the tablet, boombox and /music showed "That did not work"
ESX admins in the admin or superadmin group can open /musicadmin
Job-locked DJ sets: only that job and grade can connect, play or request songs, admins included
Job-locked karaoke stages now check grade and duty
Off-duty ESX players no longer pass job locks
New QB-Core (qb-inventory) and ox_core support fixed
New config switches to turn off car audio, boomboxes, DJ sets, karaoke and jams
Car audio no longer follows the old driver after someone else takes the wheel
Picking up someone else's boombox as admin returns the item to its owner
Song titles with accents, Cyrillic or emoji no longer fail on latin1 databases; tables are converted on start
Home page fixed on MariaDB strict mode
Lyrics and covers are no longer marked missing for a day after a timeout
Tablet, prompts and the hand prop no longer get stuck after quick open/close, death or restart
Boombox placement, car prompts and DJ/karaoke props cleaned up when leaving or restarting
